(2) ENEMY-SIDE WATER (RI-WLD10 SS5 R5/R6): every real (non-dummy/non-prop) enemy archetype -- beast_slitherfang, champion_hist_marked, cst_sap_speaker, drowned_greater, drowned_lesser, guard_legion, inf_trash -- now declares water_native and water_max_band, with 4 native at W5 (beast_slitherfang: 'mire-crab, chitin-armoured'; drowned_greater/lesser: literally the drowned; inf_trash: its own material note says 'Naga levy', and Naga is itself one of RI-CHR02's two amphibious PLAYER races). (3) THE WATERLINE (RI-WLD10 SS10.3 / ARBITRATION S25): game/src/render/actor.js's buildSkeleton() now installs a per-actor onBeforeCompile shader patch on the skin and cloth materials -- a shared {uWaterY, uWetness} uniform pair per actor, read in the fragment shader as a world-space cutoff against the already-world-space post-skinning vertex position (the same 'bones are written in world space, group transform is identity' guarantee the file's own header already documents for the weapon).
